preconditions.description: The number of blocks n and m are within the specified range [1, 200000].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= length <= 1000000 and char.islower() and len(char) == 1 for length, char in t_blocks + s_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each block in both t and s has a length between 1 and 1,000,000 and a single lowercase English letter.
The parsed lists of blocks for t and s have lengths exactly n and m respectively.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for p in range(len(t_expanded) - len(s_expanded) + 1) if t_expanded[p:p+len(s_expanded)] == s_expanded)
postconditions.description: The output integer equals the count of all starting positions p where the substring of the expanded string t starting at p matches the expanded string s.

postconditions.expression: t_expanded == ''.join(char * length for length, char in t_blocks) and s_expanded == ''.join(char * length for length, char in s_blocks)
postconditions.description: The expanded strings t_expanded and s_expanded are constructed by concatenating each block's character repeated by its length.
